run_distributed_training: run distributed training with FSDP or DeepSpeed on a tiny Qwen2 causal LM using synthetic data
test_eval_output: test the trainer evaluates the model and writes evaluation metrics to a JSON output file
run_with_custom_dtype: run training with a custom model dtype such as bf16, fp16, or fp32 via command-line argument
run_with_custom_attn: run training with a custom attention implementation specified via command-line argument
summarize_loss_history: summarize per-step training losses saved to a JSON file for equivalence testing
